name: Barbell Seated Bradford Press
steps: Sit tall on a bench with feet planted firmly and hold a barbell across your front shoulders slightly wider than shoulder width.
Brace your core tightly so your torso stays upright and calm.
Press the bar just high enough to clear the crown of your head and lower it smoothly behind your head to ear level.
Press immediately back over your head and lower to your front shoulders to complete one repetition.
tips: Keep your head still and neutral rather than ducking forward as the bar clears it.
Maintain steady tension without pausing at full lockout overhead.
